configuration_scope: Default is canonical estimator_config={} on the SAME final candidate source; balanced is the previously explored role-specific accuracy/CPU tradeoff, not a global optimum. Fast is a secondary prior selection.

methods.accuracy: Role macro: equal capture means within six backend/workload groups, then equal group means. Workload MAPE: scored-row pooled. Primary comparison uses the default/balanced intersection after the first 10 input rows, regardless of prediction availability.
methods.cpu: 12 matched rounds, getrusage user+system CPU, original-row-weighted pools. Compute paired percentages and speedups within each round, then report their medians. Shared fixed hasher; no fitting or update algorithm changes.
